Descriptions.ShortDescription: Equipment inventory and rig planning inside N.I.N.A.
Descriptions.LongDescription: AstroRig keeps one equipment inventory for multiple imaging rigs. Review payload, backfocus, image scale, and field of view. See occupied filter-wheel slots in the rig table, hover over equipment for its saved specs, and export to Excel. To start, open Imaging > AstroRig and create an inventory or open the same JSON file used by standalone AstroRig. Download the plugin ZIP from the homepage or release notes, extract it into %LOCALAPPDATA%\NINA\Plugins\3.0.0\AstroRig with N.I.N.A. closed, then restart.
